title: Juvenile Bigfoot on Film / Open Lines
byline: Coast to Coast AM Staff - November 14, 2026
excerpt: Researcher Jan Maccabee revealed the history of a rare Patterson-Gimlin film and its alleged footage of a juvenile Bigfoot. Open Lines followed during the latter half of the program.
content:
Guest host Connie Willis (info) welcomed researcher Jan Maccabee for a discussion on the history of a rare Patterson-Gimlin film. Maccabee recalled meeting her late husband, Dr. Bruce Maccabee, in 1999 after he discovered her website, which featured research for a book about UFO sightings across the United States. Sharing an interest in unexplained phenomena, they developed a relationship that led to their marriage on Valentine's Day in 2012. She described Bruce, a renowned optical physicist and UFO researcher, as kind, gentle, soft-spoken, and adventurous. Before their wedding ceremony, Bruce surprised her with an extraordinary gift: a 16mm film labeled as a reversal of the famous Patterson-Gimlin Bigfoot footage.

Maccabee explained that Bruce had acquired the film from researcher John Eric Beckjord, whom he had financially supported during a European expedition to investigate crop circles and Beckjord, who was terminally ill, offered the valuable film to Bruce in repayment of the money he owed. Bruce later gave it to Jan as a wedding present and formally transferred ownership to her for $1, documenting the transaction with notarized paperwork. She said Beckjord had also provided a notarized letter explaining the film's provenance and potential value. Jan later consulted an attorney about protecting her ownership and said the film is securely stored outside her home.

Maccabee maintained that the film is the long-missing 16mm camera-original reversal footage of the 1967 Patterson-Gimlin encounter, rather than a later copy. She said it remains in excellent condition, having been projected only about seven times, and that Bruce corresponded with researchers about its characteristics. Maccabee claimed their examination revealed footage absent from commonly circulated versions: a small, juvenile Bigfoot standing near a tree as the larger creature, known as Patty, walked away. According to Maccabee, the juvenile then moved toward its presumed mother and disappeared behind rocks and vegetation. She described Bruce's astonishment at the discovery and suggested the footage could offer previously unseen evidence from the historic encounter.

During Open Lines, Michael from West Virginia described a frightening experience in Parkersburg in September 2019, claiming that two state police officers armed with shotguns intended to kill him before a superior officer intervened and contacted a senator who ordered them to stand down. He alleged that the officers' uniforms transformed into suits, their heads became computers, and their police vehicles changed into different makes and models. Michael also recounted a subsequent incident near Athens, Ohio, where he claimed an unseen force lifted and stretched his body while his surroundings appeared to disappear.

Mike in California recounted unusual experiences following a wildfire that displaced him from his home, including sightings of UFOs, mysterious lights, and shadowy creatures. While camping near an abandoned mining area, he claimed to have witnessed sections of the ground opening into portals from which dark figures emerged. He described seeing as many as ten openings along a nearby embankment, including one large enough to enter, although he remained inside his van with his frightened dog. Mike also reported photographing strange, partially transparent forms resembling cannonballs, and encountering unexplained lights that followed his vehicle for about 50 miles.

Joseph from Monterey, California, suggested that Bigfoot may possess intelligence and abilities far beyond those of humans, including telepathic communication and interdimensional travel. He theorized that these creatures maintain a hidden civilization and deliberately avoid leaving physical evidence because they understand humanity's tendency to exploit discoveries for destructive purposes. Joseph also speculated that extraterrestrial beings may similarly limit contact with humans because they fear advanced knowledge could be weaponized. He argued that greater spiritual and psychic development could help humanity establish peaceful contact with such beings.
